protocol: Each member is a priority list. Masked members keep the archived one-pass bank's feature mask for their seed and order the kept tags by taxonomy association; random-order members keep every tag and shuffle them with the member seed plus the fold. Every member is filled in three ways: cell medoids, cell medoids backfilled with pooled values, and pooled values alone. The ensemble predicts the fitting-fold path with least total native 71-adic distance to the member predictions, smallest code on ties, for every prefix of the fixed roster. The first archived one-pass member is refitted on every fold and must reproduce its archived minimum-valuation score. Folds have equal weight.
